text:
incident-bot: PAGED: prod-runtime-gpu-2 - multiple OOMs & 503s detected (P1). Pager: anya li.

anya li: picking this up, taking command. quick triage in channel. :wave:

mike ramos: on-call too, standing by for which pools affected.

anya li: primary pools: llama-13b-quant-prod, mosaic-7b-8bit-prod. Metric spikes: rapid kvcache.pagewalks + allocator retry counts.

cheng wu: grabbing node metrics and /var/log/runtime. sharing nvidia snapshot.

cheng wu: ```
# nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,memory.total,memory.used,utilization.gpu --format=csv
0, A100-SXM4-80GB, 81920 MiB, 79512 MiB, 94 %
1, A100-SXM4-80GB, 81920 MiB, 79840 MiB, 96 %
```

cheng wu: runtime tail: 

cheng wu: ```
[02:59:12] allocator: cudaMalloc failed after retry=3 size=2472 MiB
[02:59:12] runtime: batch=16 seq=640 -> oom
[02:59:13] kvcache: pagewalks=241 ttl_evictions=0 shard=3
[02:59:13] watchdog: kill pid=4820 (serve) due to OOM
```

nora patel: support reports ~1.2k errors in last 8m, 3 customers over 5% error threshold. marking as customer-impacting and notifying accounts.

anya li: mitigation steps immediate: 1) reduce per-model batch_size to 8 2) enable aggressive kvcache eviction (ttl=25s + shrink factor=0.5) 3) introduce fallback routing to a lower-memory model for heavy routes. applying step 1 now.

mike ramos: recommend routing rule: when queue_depth>250 route to mosaic-7b-int8. Also cap max_tokens=256 on high queue routes. will roll these now.

cheng wu: pushed batch override for llama-13b-quant-prod -> batch_size=8. added routing rule to route to mosaic-7b-int8 when qd>250.

julia kim: performed hot-restart of the serving worker on node -> restarted successfully, watching for churn.

cheng wu: post-mit snapshot:

cheng wu: ```
# nvidia-smi
0, A100, memory.used=60500 MiB
1, A100, memory.used=60800 MiB
```

anya li: error rate dropped from ~6.8% to ~0.7% over 4 minutes. keeping mitigations in place.

mike ramos: timeline so far: 02:58 first alloc fail alarm; 02:59 mass oom and kvcache pagewalk surge; 03:01 applied batch_size and routing fallback; 03:03 restarts completed; 03:07 errors decreasing.

nora patel: uploading affected traces to gs://redwood-incidents/prod/runtime/1710578700/ and notifying impacted accounts with interim note + credits offer.

cheng wu: hypotheses:
- H1: kvcache fragmentation + aging pages increased cudaMalloc contention -> allocator couldn't satisfy large contiguous allocations under concurrent batching.
- H2: a quantization rollout 12h ago changed tensor alignment / workspace layout causing slightly higher peak working set on some kernels.
- H3: traffic profile shifted (90th pct seq length spiked) and concurrent batches went above what autoscaler assumed.

julia kim: rollout metadata: llama-13b-quant v2 deployed 2026-03-14T14:12Z. 95th pct seq length rose from 420->470 in last day.

anya li: action items to validate RCA: collect dmesg & kernel OOM logs, dump jemalloc/cuda allocator stats, export kvcache shard metrics and eviction histograms, get model binary checksums for both quant variants, and run synthetic repro with observed seq length distribution.

incident-bot: ACTIONS assigned -> anya li (lead), cheng wu (logs+metrics owner), mike ramos (routing + rollback), julia kim (restart + profiling), nora patel (customer comms). target: first RCA draft in 3h.

mike ramos: as temporary safety we also capped per-request tokens to 256 on the heaviest routes. will revert after RCA validated.

cheng wu: uploaded parsing script and a short CSV with offending requests. quick finding: many failed requests had seq>600 and batch 16.

julia kim: scheduling deeper memory fragmentation profiling during a quieter window to reproduce allocator behavior.

nora patel: customer updates sent. highlighting mitigation (fallback routing + batch caps) and ETA for RCA.

anya li: provisional root cause: likely combination of recent quant variant altering peak alloc layout + unusually high concurrent large batches which exposed KV cache retention patterns and led to transient fragmentation-based OOMs. will confirm with repro and allocator traces.

anya li: leaving mitigations in place until we have repro/rollback test. closing incident page once RCA gist is published. thanks team. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: CLOSED: prod-runtime-gpu-2 at 2026-03-15T03:08Z - mitigations successful, follow-ups assigned.
